lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad marai man maaneeai saache saachee soi ||33||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, the mind is pleased and appeased. True is the reputation of those who are true. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu dukh saagar hai bikh dutar tariaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is a treacherous ocean of pain and poison, which cannot be crossed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa meraa karade pach mue haumai karat vihaai ||
lines.translation: Screaming, "Mine, mine!", they rot and die; they pass their lives in egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukhaa uravaar na paar hai adh vich rahe lapataai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are in limbo, neither on this side, nor the other; they are stuck in the middle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s kamaavanaa karanaa kachhoo na jaai ||
lines.translation: They act as they are pre-destined; they cannot do anything else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee giaan ratan man vasai sabh dekhiaa braham subhaai ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the jewel of spiritual wisdom abides in the mind, and then God is easily seen in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਚੜੈ ਤੇ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur bohithai vadabhaagee chaRai te bhaujal paar la(n)ghaai ||34||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the very fortunate ones embark on the Boat of the True Guru; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur daataa ko nahee jo har naam dei aadhaar ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, there is no giver who can bestow the Support of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te naau man vasai sadaa rahai ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Name comes to dwell in the mind; keep it enshrined in your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisanaa bujhai tipat hoi har kai naai piaar ||
lines.translation: The fire of desire is extinguished, and one finds satisfaction, through the Love of the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai har apanee kirapaa dhaar ||35||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, when He showers His Mercy. ||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਰਲਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai jagat baraliaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, the world is so insane, that it cannot even be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har rakhe se ubare sabad rahe liv laai ||
lines.translation: Those who are protected by the Lord are saved; they remain lovingly attuned to the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਖੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa jin rakhee banat banaai ||36||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Creator who made this making knows everything. ||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥਾ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਥਕੇ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: hom jag sabh teerathaa paRhi pa(n)dit thake puraan ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, have grown weary of making fire-offerings and sacrifices, making pilgrimages to all the sacred shrines, and reading the Puraanas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh maaiaa mohu na mitaee vich haumai aavan jaan ||
lines.translation: But they cannot get rid of the poison of emotional attachment to Maya; they continue to come and go in egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai mal utaree har japiaa purakh sujaan ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, one's filth is washed off, meditating on the Lord, the Primal Being, the All-knowing One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa har har prabh seviaa jan naanak sad kurabaan ||37||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who serve their Lord God. ||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤਵਦੇ ਬਹੁ ਆਸਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu bahu chitavade bahu aasaa lobh vikaar ||
lines.translation: Mortals give great thought to Maya and emotional attachment; they harbor great hopes, in greed and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh asathir naa theeai mar binas jaai khin vaar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not become steady and stable; they die and are gone in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੈ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaag hovai satigur milai haumai tajai vikaar ||
lines.translation: Only those who are blessed with great good fortune meet the True Guru, and leave behind their egotism and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਪਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: har naamaa jap sukh paaiaa jan naanak sabad veechaar ||38||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, they find peace; servant Nanak contemplates the Word of the Shabad. ||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur bhagat na hovaee naam na lagai piaar ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, there is no devotional worship, and no love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam araadhiaa gur kai het piaar ||39||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak worships and adores the Naam, with love and affection for the Guru. ||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobhee kaa vesaahu na keejai je kaa paar vasaai ||
lines.translation: Do not trust greedy people, if you can avoid doing so.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਧੁਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kaal tithai dhuhai jithai hath na paai ||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, they will deceive you there, where no one will be able to lend a helping hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਦਾਗੁ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh setee sa(n)g kare muhi kaalakh daag lagaai ||
lines.translation: Whoever associates with the self-willed manmukhs, will have his face blackened and dirtied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਲੋਭੀਆਂ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: muh kaale tinh lobheeaa(n) jaasan janam gavaai ||
lines.translation: Black are the faces of those greedy people; they lose their lives, and leave in disgrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat har mel prabh har naam vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, let me join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; may the Name of the Lord God abide in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee mal utarai jan naanak har gun gaai ||40||
lines.translation: The filth and pollution of birth and death is washed away, O servant Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur har prabh karatai likhiaa s metanaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: Whatever is pre-destined by the Lord God Creator, cannot be erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis daa pratipaal kare har raai ||
lines.translation: Body and soul are all His. The Sovereign Lord King cherishes all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੁਗਲ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਭੁਖੇ ਰੁਲਿ ਮੁਏ ਏਨਾ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chugal ni(n)dak bhukhe rul mue enaa hath na kithaaoo paai ||
lines.translation: The gossipers and slanderers shall remain hungry and die, rolling in the dust; their hands cannot reach anywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਸਭ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar paakha(n)d sabh karam karahi man hiradai kapat kamaai ||
lines.translation: Outwardly, they do all the proper deeds, but they are hypocrites; in their minds and hearts, they practice deception and fraud.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤਿ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਖਲੋਆ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khet sareer jo beejeeai so a(n)t khaloaa aai ||
lines.translation: Whatever is planted in the farm of the body, shall come and stand before them in the end.
